Transform for FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetAlert> for mapping the ReliabilityAsset assetImportanceLevel.displayName into the
ReliabilityAsset assetImportanceLevel.importanceLevel field.
This is done so that the UiSdlDataGrid component can "natively" support sorting by assetImportanceLevel.importanceLevel while displaying just assetImportanceLevel.displayName.
